components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action button. Deep blue background, white text, 44px height.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; background: oklch(0.45 0.16 250); color: oklch(1.00 0 0); font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.38 0.14 250); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.53 0.18 250); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action button. Bordered, transparent background.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; background: oklch(1.00 0 0); color: oklch(0.15 0.015 260); font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.005 260); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.98 0.003 260); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.53 0.18 250); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input with label, error state, and focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; } .ds-input-label { margin-bottom: 6px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.15 0.015 260); } .ds-input { height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; background: oklch(1.00 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.005 260); border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.15 0.015 260); transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.50 0.015 260); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.53 0.18 250); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.53 0.18 250 / 0.2); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.description: Content container with subtle border and shadow.

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Dark sidebar with navigation links. Collapses to icons on mobile.
components.css: .ds-sidebar { width: 256px; height: 100vh; background: oklch(0.18 0.03 260); padding: 16px 8px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.70 0.01 260); text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms, color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: oklch(0.22 0.04 260); color: oklch(1.00 0 0); } .ds-nav-active { background: oklch(0.25 0.05 260); color: oklch(1.00 0 0); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Status indicator pill. Used for schedule types, payment status, stock levels.
components.html: PaidExpiredLow Stock
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-badge-success { background: oklch(0.93 0.06 145); color: oklch(0.37 0.12 145); } .ds-badge-danger { background: oklch(0.93 0.04 25); color: oklch(0.40 0.16 25); } .ds-badge-warning { background: oklch(0.93 0.06 80); color: oklch(0.45 0.12 80); } .ds-badge-primary { background: oklch(0.93 0.04 250); color: oklch(0.38 0.14 250); }

narrative.overview:
A pharmacy counter where every medicine has its place, every label is clear, and the pharmacist's hand moves with practiced efficiency. PharmaPOS translates that physical precision into a digital interface. The system is dense by design: a pharmacist checking stock needs to see batch numbers, expiry dates, quantities, and prices simultaneously. Progressive disclosure is reserved for settings and configuration, never for the dispensing workflow.

The color strategy is Restrained: tinted neutrals for the surface, one saturated primary accent for actions and selection. This is not a dashboard that needs to impress; it is a tool that needs to work. The OKLCH color space ensures perceptual uniformity across all tones, so a warning amber reads as urgently at 50% lightness as it does at 90%.

The single typeface (Inter) carries the full hierarchy through weight and size contrast. Tabular numerals ensure prices and quantities align vertically for quick scanning. The dark sidebar and light content area create clear spatial hierarchy without decorative elements.
keyCharacteristics: Information density as a feature, not a problem
Single accent color (blue at hue 250) for all interactive elements
Semantic color vocabulary: primary for actions, success for confirmation, danger for errors/expiry, warning for alerts
Dark sidebar with light content area for spatial hierarchy
Inter as sole typeface with tabular numerals for numeric data
44px minimum touch targets on all interactive elements

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: The primary accent appears only on interactive elements and active states. It never decorates. Its scarcity is the point; when you see blue, you know you can click it.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: All numeric data (prices, quantities, dates) uses tabular figures. A pharmacist comparing stock levels across batches must be able to scan vertically without numbers jumping left and right.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, elevation, focus). No decorative shadows, no multi-layer depth effects, no inset shadows on inputs.

dos: Use semantic color tokens (text-text, bg-surface, border-border) instead of hard-coded gray/white values
Use OKLCH for all color definitions
Maintain 44px minimum touch targets on all interactive elements
Show both AD and Bikram Sambat dates
Format currency as NPR with lakh/crore notation (रू 1,00,000)
Use Inter's tabular figures for all numeric data
Keep the sidebar dark and the content area light
Use focus-visible rings on all interactive elements
donts: Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, or decorative blur effects
Don't use identical card grids with icon + big number + small label
Don't use purple gradients, neon accents, or crypto-aesthetic
Don't use playful fonts, rounded bubbly shapes, or gamification
Don't use em dashes in UI copy
Don't use bounce or elastic easing animations
Don't hide data behind progressive disclosure in the dispensing workflow
